name: Browman Mill
summary: Undead now crowd Browman Mill, north of Light's Hope Chapel. Once it served Lordaeron's timber trade; now Stephen Browman remains trapped in death within his ruined workshop.

sections.title: A Ruined Industry
sections.body: Before the Third War, Browman Mill worked timber from the Eastweald for nearby towns and homesteads. Then the Scourge plague swept across Lordaeron, and the mill fell with the province. Now rotting timbers and shattered wheels lie idle while abominations, banshees, and skeletal warriors patrol the grounds. So close to Light's Hope Chapel, the ruins show how near the undead horde has come to the Argent Dawn.

sections.title: The Overseer's Fate
sections.body: Stephen Browman owned Browman Mill before the Scourge overran his estate. The Scourge killed him and raised him as a ghoul, bound to the Lich King's will. He remains in the dark mill, guarding the broken remains of his life's work.

faq.answer: Browman Mill lies in the far eastern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands, directly north of Light's Hope Chapel.

faq.q: What kind of enemies inhabit the mill?
faq.answer: Abominations, banshees, skeletal warriors, and ghouls fill Browman Mill's grounds.
Stephen Browman owned and operated the lumber mill. The Scourge killed him during Lordaeron's fall and raised him as a ghoul, bound to guard the ruined mill.

faq.q: Why is Browman Mill dangerous to travelers?
faq.answer: Powerful undead infest Browman Mill, making it dangerous to travelers. The mill lies a short ride north of the Argent Dawn stronghold at Light's Hope Chapel.

angles.text: As a paladin, you see the desecrated mill and its tormented spirits as the evils the holy orders fight to cleanse from Lordaeron.
As an undead, you know Stephen Browman's enslavement recalls those claimed by the Lich King and denied the free will the Forsaken won.
